verdict.rationale: Exa's search response schema includes a publishedDate field (plus author), and the docs describe Search returning ranked results with URLs, with published-date filtering in the SDK. That is direct, citation-relevant metadata. However, no evidence shows a title field or guarantees that URLs are canonical, so the story is only roughly half evidenced. Missing for 10: documented title field, explicit canonical-URL guarantee, independent or hands-on corroboration of metadata accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on results carrying canonical URLs, titles, and published dates so my app can cite sources accurately

citations.quote: All contents features are also available in Exa Search for returned URLs
